mod.name: TB Death Insurance
mod.summary: Players buy insurance at insurance points; when they die, they can claim their insured gear from an insurance case. Plans differ in price, duration and premium status.
mod.notes: Docs list different defaults than the sample for some values (for example heirs 10 vs 2, transfer delay 10 vs 20); the app shows the sample defaults. With inventory-expanding mods not all gear may be saved. Admin rights come from Global/AdminConfig (deathInsurance); prices use Global/CurrencyConfig.

files.title: Insurance blacklist
files.summary: Items that are never insured. Supports wildcard patterns.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

blacklistedItems.label: Blacklisted items
blacklistedItems.help: Item class names that are never insured. Supports exact names and wildcards: *text*, text* and *text.
blacklistedItems.risk: The blacklist does nothing when an insurance uses insureOnlyItemsThatAreAtTheMomentInCargoAndInventory = 1.

blacklistedItems[].label: Item or pattern
blacklistedItems[].help: Class name or wildcard pattern (for example *Rifle*) of items to exclude from insurance. Case-sensitive.

files.title: Death Insurance settings
files.summary: Main settings and the list of insurance plans players can buy.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

maximumHeirsForOneInheritance.label: Max heirs per inheritance
maximumHeirsForOneInheritance.help: Caps how many heirs can be named for one inheritance.

insuranceCaseWillDeletedAfterSeconds.label: Delete unclaimed case after
insuranceCaseWillDeletedAfterSeconds.help: How long an insurance case (the stored gear after a death) waits for the player before it is deleted for good.
insuranceCaseWillDeletedAfterSeconds.risk: Short times make players lose their gear if they are offline.

useLocalTime.label: Use server local time
useLocalTime.help: 1 uses the server local clock for times shown or calculated; 0 uses UTC.

timeInSecondsWhenItemsWillBeTransferAfte.label: Transfer delay after death
timeInSecondsWhenItemsWillBeTransferAfte.help: Seconds after death before the items are moved into the insurance case. If above 0, items held in hands cannot be saved (see saveItemInHands).
timeInSecondsWhenItemsWillBeTransferAfte.risk: While it is above 0, insurances with saveItemInHands = 1 cannot save hand items.

storeAllItemsInCargoOfMainItems.label: Put all items in main item cargo
storeAllItemsInCargoOfMainItems.help: 1 packs everything into the cargo of the main items (clothing) when saving; 0 keeps items where they were. Do not combine with insureOnlyItemsThatAreAtTheMomentInCargoAndInventory.

globalInsuranceBuyCooldownInSeconds.label: Global buy cooldown
globalInsuranceBuyCooldownInSeconds.help: Waiting time between any two insurance purchases by a player, overriding the per-insurance cooldown.

defaultInsuranceIDForNewPlayers.label: Default insurance for new players
defaultInsuranceIDForNewPlayers.help: Id of the insurance given automatically to players when they first spawn. Empty means none. It must match an id in the insurances list.

maximumFreeInsuranceCountForPlayers.label: Max free insurances
maximumFreeInsuranceCountForPlayers.help: Limit on how many of the free default insurances one player can receive.

hideDeleteItemsButton.label: Hide delete button
hideDeleteItemsButton.help: 1 hides the button players use to delete the items in an insurance case; 0 shows it.

insurances.label: Insurances
insurances.help: The insurance plans players can buy at an insurance point.

insurances[].id.label: Plan id
insurances[].id.help: Unique name of the plan. Other settings (such as the default insurance) refer to it, so keep it unique and unchanged once players own it.
insurances[].id.risk: Duplicate or changed ids can orphan existing player insurances.

insurances[].price.label: Price
insurances[].price.help: Cost of the plan in the configured currency.
insurances[].price.risk: A price of 0 makes the plan free for everyone.

insurances[].durationInSeconds.label: Duration
insurances[].durationInSeconds.help: How long the plan stays active after purchase.

insurances[].stayActiveAfterDeath.label: Stay active after death
insurances[].stayActiveAfterDeath.help: 1 keeps the plan active after it paid out, so it covers the next death too; 0 uses it up on the first death.

insurances[].insureOnlyItemsThatAreAtThe.label: Insure only inventory and cargo
insurances[].insureOnlyItemsThatAreAtThe.help: 1 insures only what is in inventory and cargo at the moment of death. This needs storeAllItemsInCargoOfMainItems = 0 and makes the blacklist ineffective.

insurances[].canBuyAgainAfterSeconds.label: Re-buy cooldown
insurances[].canBuyAgainAfterSeconds.help: How long a player must wait before buying this plan again. The global cooldown overrides it when set.

special.-1: can buy again at any time

insurances[].isPremium.label: Premium only
insurances[].isPremium.help: 1 makes the plan available only to premium players; 0 for everyone.

insurances[].isBuyable.label: Buyable
insurances[].isBuyable.help: 0 hides the plan from the shop so it can only be given automatically (for example as a free starter plan); 1 lets players buy it.

insurances[].saveItemInHands.label: Save item in hands
insurances[].saveItemInHands.help: 1 also saves the item the player held in the hands. It only works when timeInSecondsWhenItemsWillBeTransferAfterDeathOfPlayer is 0.
insurances[].saveItemInHands.risk: Ignored while the transfer delay is above 0.

files.title: Insurance points
files.summary: Where the insurance machines or NPCs stand on the map.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Internal version number of this file format. The mod manages it; do not edit.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Internal marker the mod sets after it has created the file. Do not change it.

insurancePoints.label: Insurance points
insurancePoints.help: Places on the map where players can buy and claim insurance.

insurancePoints[].label: Insurance point
insurancePoints[].help: One insurance machine or NPC with its place.

insurancePoints[].position.label: Position
insurancePoints[].position.help: World coordinates of the point as three numbers: x, y (height) and z.

insurancePoints[].position[].label: Coordinate
insurancePoints[].position[].help: One of the three world coordinates (x, height, z).

insurancePoints[].orientation.label: Orientation
insurancePoints[].orientation.help: Facing angles of the point as three numbers; usually only the first one matters and the others stay 0.

insurancePoints[].orientation[].label: Angle
insurancePoints[].orientation[].help: One of the three angles in degrees.

insurancePoints[].machineType.label: Machine class
insurancePoints[].machineType.help: Class name of the insurance machine. Custom types must extend TBDIMachine.

insurancePoints[].useExactPosition.label: Use exact position
insurancePoints[].useExactPosition.help: 1 places the point exactly at the given coordinates; 0 snaps it to the ground.

insurancePoints[].enableNpcTrader.label: Spawn NPC
insurancePoints[].enableNpcTrader.help: 1 also spawns an NPC at the point; 0 places the machine only.

insurancePoints[].npcType.label: NPC class
insurancePoints[].npcType.help: Class name of the NPC. Only used when Spawn NPC is 1.

insurancePoints[].npcGearSetName.label: NPC gear set
insurancePoints[].npcGearSetName.help: Name of the outfit for the NPC (a file in Global/GearSets, created if missing). Only used with an NPC.
